settings.title: Make room for your style.
settings.subtitle: Small details that make Tastellar feel like home.
settings.appearanceBody: A different atmosphere. The same personal universe.
settings.readingBody: Warm paper tones for long reading sessions.
settings.textSizeBody: Give the words a little more breathing room.
settings.scenesBody: Show or hide the interactive scenes in your Library.
settings.rememberSidebarsPerTabBody: Keep the left and right sidebars open or closed independently in each tab.
settings.restore: Pick up where you left off
settings.restoreBody: Restore your tabs when Tastellar opens.
settings.startupBody: Used when restoring tabs is turned off.
settings.shortcutsBody: Click a shortcut, then press a new combination. Text fields keep their usual arrow-key behavior.
settings.shortcutInvalid: Use Control, Option or Command with a key. This shortcut is reserved or already used.
settings.dataBody: Your profile, library, ratings and settings are stored on this device. Keep a portable archive of your Tastellar data whenever you like.
settings.archiveBody: A portable archive includes your profile and all stories, ratings, tags, and media types. It stays on this device until you choose where to save it.
settings.previewData: Open the desktop app to save and restore backups. This browser preview does not store data.
settings.restoreWarning: This replaces your current profile, stories, ratings, tags, media types, taste priorities and preferences. Tastellar saves a recovery copy first.
settings.aboutBody: A personal library for everything that stays with you. Built to live on your device.
settings.tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
settings.openLibraryCredit: Book editions and cover data from
settings.googleBooksCredit: Book search and bibliographic data from
settings.resetWorkspaceBody: Permanently delete the data Tastellar manages on this device and return to a clean setup.
settings.resetConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your profile and picture, library entries and covers, custom media types, criteria and tags, ratings and history, taste priorities, rating guidelines, trash, preferences, workspace layout, managed assets, and Tastellar-managed backups on this device. This cannot be undone. Exported archive files saved elsewhere are not affected.
settings.resetRankingBody: Clear duel answers, sessions, and manual ranking positions from this library. Rated works return to Unplaced; entries, overall ratings, and unscored groups remain. Existing backups and exported archives are unchanged.
settings.resetRankingConfirmBody: This clears duel answers, sessions, manual placement signals, and ranking history from this library. All rated works return to Unplaced. Your library entries, 1–10 overall ratings, reviews, criteria, tags, and unscored groups remain. Existing backups and exported archives are unchanged; restoring one may restore its ranking history.
settings.resetRankingDone: Ranking reset. Your works and overall ratings are unchanged.
settings.atmosphereNote: The atmosphere changes. Your taste stays yours.
settings.supportBody: Tastellar has no ads or subscriptions, and every feature is free. If the project is useful to you, your support helps it keep growing.
settings.supportReminderBody: Tastellar has no ads or subscriptions, and the app is free. If you enjoy using it, please consider supporting the project.
